upcomingReleases.name: Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro "Mambacita"
upcomingReleases.description: A low-cut Protro silhouette in White/Black-Metallic Gold, honoring Kobe Bryant's legacy. Features responsive Zoom Air cushioning and a sleek streamlined design. Retailing at $200.

upcomingReleases.name: Adidas Harden Vol. 10 x Jalen Williams
upcomingReleases.description: A collaboration with NBA star Jalen Williams featuring BOOST + Lightstrike Pro cushioning, a textile upper with molded support, and bold concentric ripple overlays. $160.

upcomingReleases.name: Nike LeBron 23 "Old Glory"
upcomingReleases.description: Released as part of the WNBA 30th Anniversary celebration, the LeBron 23 packs LeBron's signature cushioning tech into a premium court-ready package. $210.

upcomingReleases.name: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro "Draft Day"
upcomingReleases.description: An engineered mesh low-top Protro paying tribute to a pivotal moment in Kobe's career. Lightweight construction with responsive Zoom Air cushioning. $190.

upcomingReleases.name: Air Jordan 5 "Black/University Blue"
upcomingReleases.description: The iconic AJ5 silhouette returns in a clean Black/University Blue colorway with signature Air cushioning and the Jumpman branding. A must-have retro drop. $220.
